crypto/constant_time#

Equality of two byte strings whose running time does not depend on where they differ (host subtle).

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

ConstantTimeEqual(left: expected, right: supplied).matches();

Description#

Equality of two byte strings whose running time does not depend on where they differ (host subtle). Different lengths are unequal; the length itself is not secret. Use it for MAC tags, tokens and password digests.

A key or token kept as SecretBytes compares itself: stored.matches(supplied).

Public API#

object ConstantTimeEqual#

object ConstantTimeEqual

Whether two byte strings are equal, in time that does not depend on where they differ: for comparing tags and tokens.
